title: Thousands of ayahuasca users report meeting the same all-knowing goddess
summary: Luke Caverns tells of Thousands of ayahuasca users report meeting the same all-knowing goddess, about present day at Amazon, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And they take Iawaska and they will meet a goddess down and and you have thousands of reports of people meeting this similar goddess being woman that automatically knows everything that's wrong with you

plain: Ayahuasca is a plant brew from the Amazon that people drink for strong visions. A researcher named Luke Caverns tells podcast host Jesse Michels that there are thousands of reports of people on ayahuasca meeting the same goddess, a woman who knows at once everything that is wrong with you. If true, it would hint that the visions show something real that many people meet, not just private dreams.
